guide.timothatys_trinkets.holiness.holy_: Grants Healing Presence to the wearer and Pact of Alliance allies within 8 blocks, increasing NATURAL and HOLY healing by 35%.
Passively grants +4 maximum health. Every 2 points of current health increase Holy Damage dealt by 3%, up to 35%.

Confession prevents your damage to villagers and iron golems, grants a 25% Cleric trade discount, and lets a nearby Cleric heal you for 2 + 20% maximum health at or below half health (120-second cooldown).
Passively grants the wearer of this bead combination the Angel's Shroud effect when their health drops below 20%, converting all incoming damage into healing. Cooldown: 240 seconds.
Activate Cherubim's Wisdom for 15 seconds by spending 40-100 raw XP. It grants +25% direct melee and launch-empowered projectile damage, or +15% holy damage. Cooldown: 25 seconds.

Even the faintest prayer spoken while holding this holy relic can wound the eternal darkness that lingers upon this sinful world. The rosarium is adorned with precious golden angel wings, and their gold still shines even when all hope seems lost.

This exquisitely crafted rosarium may be adorned with three different sacred beads, each carrying a vow of humility, a miracle of sacrament, or the gift of eternal life. These beads are scattered across the world, hidden in places far apart from one another. They are so precious that even cursed beings, such as necromancers, seek to claim them for their dark rituals, desecrating the sacred purpose these beads were meant to serve.
Suppresses Unholy Relics while worn and grants unique bonuses based on the selected combination of beads.

Slot-count bonuses from two identical beads do not stack, and unique modifiers/passive abilities are not granted when two identical beads are placed in the slots. Keep this in mind when combining beads.
guide.timothatys_trinkets.holiness.pact_: The Pacts of Alliance are written and then consecrated by the patriarchs of the sacred order of paladins. They carry within them the energy of holiness, which envelops those bound by the pact and shields them from any relic-born influence.

The ink with which the names of those deemed friends are inscribed upon the pact’s pages is no ordinary ink. Like all things belonging to the paladin order, it is sanctified, and serves as the most vital component in the successful sealing of the pact. To use any other ink is deemed desecration, and a violation of ancient tradition…
But what if it is worth the sin?

The Pact of Alliance binds up to eight players to a single one - the pact’s owner. While active, the pact nullifies any effects or damage caused by relics. Adding players to the pact costs one Holy Ink. Changing a nickname does not break the bond between players.

The Pact of Alliance binds players together, protecting them from damage caused by allied relics and preventing those relics’ effects from working on members of the alliance. However, the relic does not protect against direct melee damage or projectiles such as arrows, snowballs, and so on.

tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.belt_of_outc: By the ancient villager tradition, if a brother returns from exile, one must present him with a special gift in gratitude for his loyalty to the community - and welcome him back into the fold.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.champions_ga: The gauntlet of an undead champion, held only by those chosen by darkness itself. The cruelty of its champions needs no description; it is known already to be bloody, honed to a terrifying apex.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.cleansing_du: A pouch of dust steeped in incense. Its pleasant scent fills the lungs, easing breathing and lifting one’s spirits.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.dormant_sphe: Right-click with a dye: color the core
Shift + Right-click with a dye: color the outline
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.drums_of_has: Drums whose pounding fills their bearer with courage and a fierce battle-rage.
This sphere must never be shattered, lest the echo of hundreds of voices and screams hidden within break free from the chains of its prison - a prison eternally resonating in unison with the echo itself - and tear the eardrums of all who stand near the relic.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.empty_chalic: An empty vessel, waiting for the blood of a fallen archfoe. Use it upon their lingering remains before the last warmth fades.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.fangs.1: A necklace of vampire fangs. Seasoned hunters know such jewelry can directly influence the restoration of its wearer’s strength.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.farmers_ring: This ring gives off a pleasant aroma of herbs and spices, though none are set within it. Desperate farmers still seek it to this day, for a belief persists that the ring doubles livestock and multiplies the harvest.
A blazing sphere, recreated from volcanic stone and then heated in the embrace of a thousand suns. It still burns fiercer than its former form, and after a special ritual, its wielders were granted power capable of withstanding beings from the astral realms.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.flaming_embe: An ever-burning ember. Although it emits intense heat, it does not burn at all, even when held in the hand.
Hold [SHIFT] to see the current passive Heat Point bonuses...
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.golden_honey: The hive’s blessing, sealed in golden wax.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.holy_rosariu: A magnificent rosary, something not every village priest would have. Its original owner must have been a very well-to-do person. The rosary is adorned with splendid angelic wings, said by tradition to symbolize the village clergyman’s special status.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.necronomicon: A book whose first authors were the First Necromancers. Be afraid, for its power lies in the poisoning of all living things.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.pagans_charm: A clay likeness of a humble villager. Old rites taught it to bear what flesh was meant to suffer.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.pillagers_co: A marauder’s lucky coin. It brings fortune to those who heed no voice of conscience.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.refreshing_c: A chalice filled with the refreshing blood of an archfoe. A fragment of their strength shall flow into you.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.ritual_dagge: A ritual dagger with the energy of corruption flowing through its blade.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.rusty_armlet: Let this armlet taste battle once more...
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.rusty_gauntl: Let it taste battle once more...
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.seal_of_alli: A seal that binds souls together.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.striker_of_t: A mace head, weighty and powerful.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.undead_knigh: Darkness, gathering thick, turns the door into this world for the unholy, and undead knights are among the beings eager to savor both the fear of the living and their flesh. This runed gauntlet empowers the servants of the dark in exchange for their souls.
tooltip.timothatys_trinkets.venom_sphere: A sphere forged by the Ancients from toxic alloys laced with concentrated spider venom. The fumes of its mysterious poison swiftly corrode other metals.
A sphere drawn straight from the depths of the endless Void. Within it dwells an equally endless energy, harmful to ordinary mortals, forever seeking to break free.
